children: Intapp (NASDAQ: INTA), the governed AI platform for professional firms in highly regulated industries, announced its Celeste plug-in for ChatGPT Enterprise.

Most of the attention paid to AI in law over the past two years has gone to the practice of law, lowering the cost of legal research, drafting, and review. Far less has gone to the business of law: winning new clients, onboarding lateral partners, taking on the right matters, realizing revenue, and running the whole enterprise profitably. That is the work that decides whether or not a firm grows.

The business of law runs on a firm’s unique ways of working and knowledge. Intapp has spent more than two decades encoding this into the systems that firms depend on to grow their clients, clear their conflicts, enforce ethical walls, and capture their time. Celeste is Intapp's expert AI coworker, designed to safely scale AI to run business workflows from start to finish, under the firm's control and compliance obligations.

The most successful firms will be the ones that combine what makes them unique—their expert judgment, their methods, their proprietary data, and their compliance rules—with power of frontier AI models. Together, Celeste and OpenAI's frontier models will help firms onboard new clients and matters faster, generate more accurate billings, and free up more time for lawyers to focus on higher judgment work.
Entitled access, wherever lawyers work
Featured at today's launch, the Intapp Celeste plug-in brings a firm’s proprietary context and methods into ChatGPT Enterprise. Professionals can:
Capture work as it happens, check it against the firm's outside counsel guidelines, and bill it accurately.
Source new opportunities and prepare for client meetings, on work the firm has already cleared for conflicts.
Find an introduction to a prospect from inside the firm's own relationships.
Importantly, a lawyer reaches only what the firm has entitled them to reach. The firm's ethical walls, confidentiality obligations, and need-to-know rules apply to what Celeste returns.
This is the latest step in Intapp and OpenAI’s work to extend governed firm intelligence deeper into the way lawyers work every day.
Availability
Intapp Celeste plug-in for ChatGPT Enterprise is available to eligible Intapp Celeste clients beginning today.
Supporting quotes
Thad Jampol, Co-founder and Chief Product Officer, Intapp

“The law is the same for every firm. What a firm knows about its clients, its methods, its matters, and the judgment built from handling them for decades — that's the firm’s real franchise. We've spent more than two decades encoding it into the systems firms already run on. Being available in ChatGPT Enterprise means that firms now run inside the models lawyers are already using.”
Jason Boehmig, General Manager, Legal Industry, OpenAI

"We believe the next generation of AI for law will be built around what makes each firm distinctive – its expertise, judgment, and way of working. By building alongside Intapp, we’re turning that expertise into AI lawyers can use every day, creating new ways for firms to serve their clients and shape the future of legal work.”
